RagShortTexts: Ladoga watches the northern Volkhov route.
Defence requires repairs, guards and continuing supplies.

Variants.Content: Ladoga holds an important position on the northern Volkhov route. Watches and receipt of cargo connect its roles. Repairs, seasonal access, reports and provisions turn favorable terrain into effective protection.
Ladoga guards watch boats and land approaches and adjust for water changes. Repair parties need replacements on duty rather than leaving posts unwatched.
River revenue depends on willing carriers. Arbitrary detention blocks storage; defence and landing repairs share benefits but compete for timber and labor.
Neighbors supply food and wood and bear carrying demands. Delayed crews need actual shelter and stores rather than a fortress’s ancient reputation.
